question: With reference to the physical features of India, the ‘Kayals’ are _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Backwaters**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kayals:-**

 
 
• **These are a network of brackish lagoons and lakes found along the coast of Kerala, India. **
 
• They are formed by the action of waves and currents, which create sandbars and barrier islands that separate the lagoons from the sea.
 
• Kayals are a vital part of the Kerala ecosystem, providing a habitat for a wide variety of plants and animals, and they also play an important role in the local economy. 
 
• **Kayals are typically shallow and have a high salinity due to the mixing of freshwater from rivers and streams with seawater from the Arabian Sea. **
 
• The salinity of the kayals varies depending on the season and the amount of rainfall.
 
• During the monsoon season, when there is a lot of rainfall, the salinity of the kayals decreases.
 
• However, during the dry season, when there is very little rainfall, the salinity of the kayals increases.
